title: SAP Concur Expense Report
description: Schema for an SAP Concur Expense Report, which aggregates individual expense entries submitted by an employee for approval and reimbursement.

ID.description: The unique identifier of the expense report

Name.description: The name/title of the expense report

Total.description: Total amount of all expenses in the report in the report currency

CurrencyCode.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the report total

SubmitDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the report was submitted for approval

CreateDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime when the report was created

ProcessingPaymentDate.description: ISO 8601 datetime when payment processing began

OwnerLoginID.description: Login ID (email) of the expense report owner

OwnerName.description: Full display name of the expense report owner

PolicyID.description: Identifier of the expense policy applied to this report

HasException.description: True if the report contains entries with policy exceptions requiring justification

PurposeStatement.description: Business purpose statement for the expenses in this report

URI.description: Full URI for the expense report resource
